sections.name: OnboardingPage
sections.title: Reading and checking the destination
sections.what: Reads the next address from the web address and passes it to the onboarding screen only if it is a path on this site. Otherwise it uses the crews page.
sections.why: The same check protects against sending users to other sites after setup, as on the sign-in screen.
sections.watch_out: Any change to this check must be made in the sign-in, register, and onboarding pages together, since they each hold a copy.

summary: A route wrapper that reads where to go after onboarding and shows the onboarding screen.
purpose: Makes the onboarding address and passes a safe destination to the screen.
why: It keeps the route setup separate from the screen and applies the safe redirect check.
how: Steps in order: it reads the next address from the web address. It accepts the value only if it starts with a single slash. Otherwise it uses the crews page. Then it shows the onboarding screen with that destination.
inputs: The next value in the web address.
outputs: The onboarding screen with a safe destination.
risks: The same redirect check is copied in the sign-in, register, and onboarding pages, so a fix in one place may be missed in the others.
debug: If users land on the wrong page after onboarding, check the next value and the fallback. If the tab title is wrong, check the page title setting.
